title: 10th Standard English - Maximum Objective Questions & Official Keys (2020 to 2026)
subject: English
board: Tamil Nadu State Board SSLC Examination

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
The young seagull was alone on his ledge.

options.a: a narrow horizontal shelf projecting from a wall or cliff

questions.answer: a narrow horizontal shelf projecting from a wall or cliff
questions.explanation: 'Ledge' refers to a narrow horizontal projection forming a shelf on a cliff or wall.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
He was maddened by the sight of food.
questions.explanation: 'Maddened' means extremely annoyed or driven insane with craving.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
His father was preening the feathers on his white back.
questions.explanation: 'Preening' is the act of birds cleaning and trimming feathers using their beak.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
He cried plaintively, begging her to bring him some food.
questions.explanation: 'Plaintively' means sounding sad, sorrowful, or mournful.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
A monstrous terror seized him and his heart stood still.
questions.explanation: 'Monstrous' in this context means immense, frightful, and overwhelming.

questions.prose_lesson: The Night the Ghost Got In
questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
The slamming of the doors had aroused mother.
questions.explanation: 'Slamming' means banging shut with immense force and loud noise.

questions.prose_lesson: The Night the Ghost Got In
questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
We heard a great hullabaloo on the downstairs floor.

options.a: a lot of loud noise and confusion

questions.answer: a lot of loud noise and confusion
questions.explanation: 'Hullabaloo' means a commotion, loud uproar, and confusing clamour.

questions.prose_lesson: The Night the Ghost Got In
questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
Grandfather was in an indignant state of mind.

options.a: feeling or showing anger at perceived unfairness

questions.answer: feeling or showing anger at perceived unfairness
questions.explanation: 'Indignant' means expressing grievance and righteous displeasure or anger.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
The crew circumnavigated the globe successfully.

options.a: travelled completely around something by ship

questions.answer: travelled completely around something by ship
questions.explanation: 'Circumnavigate' means to sail or travel all the way around the world.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
They had to make stopovers for replenishment of rations.
questions.explanation: 'Replenishment' means restocking or refilling supplies to full capacity.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
We were quite apprehensive about entering the rough sea.

options.a: anxious or fearful that something bad will happen

questions.answer: anxious or fearful that something bad will happen
questions.explanation: 'Apprehensive' means being fearful, uneasy, or worried about future events.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
The road bifurcated into two distinct tracks near the banyan tree.

options.a: divided into two branches or forks

questions.answer: divided into two branches or forks
questions.explanation: 'Bifurcated' means split or branched into two separate parts.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
Aditya decided to revive childhood memories by visiting his village.

options.a: bring back to life, consciousness, or active memory

questions.answer: bring back to life, consciousness, or active memory
questions.explanation: 'Revive' means to renew, reanimate, or bring back into remembrance.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
Sasanka Sanyal looked unperturbed by the sudden entrance of visitors.

options.a: calm and not disturbed or worried

questions.answer: calm and not disturbed or worried
questions.explanation: 'Unperturbed' means undisturbed, serene, and composure intact.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
Technology has empowered disabled people to live independently.

options.a: given the authority or power to do something

questions.answer: given the authority or power to do something
questions.explanation: 'Empowered' means equipped, enabled, or authorized with independence and strength.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
He had to grapple with multiple severe communication challenges.
questions.explanation: 'Grapple' means to engage in a close fight or struggle with a heavy difficulty.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
I was in great dread of a scolding from M. Hamel.
questions.explanation: 'Dread' means anticipation with great apprehension or intense terror.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
The children recited the letters in unison.
questions.explanation: 'In unison' signifies doing something together at the same time as one voice.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
Sherlock Holmes appeared gaunt and emaciated lying in bed.

options.a: lean and haggard especially because of suffering or hunger

questions.answer: lean and haggard especially because of suffering or hunger
questions.explanation: 'Gaunt' means excessively thin, haggard, and hollow-eyed from illness.

questions.question:
Choose the correct synonym of the underlined word:
His voice was delirious as he muttered strange medical names.

options.a: in a state of wild excitement or mental confusion

questions.answer: in a state of wild excitement or mental confusion
questions.explanation: 'Delirious' denotes an acute state of feverish hallucination or incoherent speech.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The young seagull was exhausted after his strenuous effort.
questions.explanation: The opposite of being tired or exhausted is refreshed, lively, or full of energy.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
He cried plaintively for a piece of fish.
questions.explanation: 'Plaintively' means sadly; its antonym is cheerfully or gladly.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The sea stretched out vast before his fearful eyes.
questions.explanation: 'Vast' means wide and boundless; its exact antonym is narrow, small, or confined.

questions.prose_lesson: The Night the Ghost Got In
questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
Mother was in a hysterical state seeing the confusion.
questions.explanation: 'Hysterical' means wildly uncontrolled; its opposite is composed, quiet, or calm.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The crew exhibited tremendous endurance throughout the voyage.
questions.explanation: 'Endurance' means fortitude and stamina; its opposite is weakness or lack of resilience.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
We had plenty of provisions loaded onto the vessel.
questions.explanation: 'Plenty' means an ample amount; its antonym is scarcity, lack, or deficit.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
Aditya looked unperturbed even after meeting Sasanka Sanyal.
questions.explanation: 'Unperturbed' means calm and untroubled; its antonym is agitated, disturbed, or alarmed.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The prosperous jeweller examined the antique medal with care.
questions.explanation: 'Prosperous' means thriving and wealthy; its antonym is impoverished, needy, or poor.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
Technology promotes inclusion of all children in regular schools.
questions.explanation: 'Inclusion' means incorporating all; its opposite is exclusion or isolation.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
M. Hamel wore his solemn Sunday clothes for the class.
questions.explanation: 'Solemn' signifies deeply serious or grave; its antonym is lighthearted, playful, or cheerful.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The sounds were recited in unison by all pupils.
questions.explanation: 'Unison' means unity and consensus; its antonym is discord, divergence, or conflict.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
Watson observed Holmes's frail and weakened condition.
questions.explanation: 'Frail' means physically weak and delicate; its antonym is robust, sturdy, or strong.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
Culverton Smith showed immense malice towards Holmes.
questions.explanation: 'Malice' is the desire to inflict harm; its opposite is benevolence, kindness, or goodwill.

questions.question:
Choose the correct antonym of the underlined word:
The young bird was reluctant to take off from the ledge.
questions.explanation: 'Reluctant' means unwilling and hesitant; its antonym is eager or willing.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'alumnus':
questions.explanation: The Latin masculine noun 'alumnus' changes to 'alumni' in plural.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'matrix':
questions.explanation: Nouns ending in '-ix' of Latin origin pluralize to '-ices' (matrix -> matrices).

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'focus':
questions.explanation: Latin '-us' changes to '-i', yielding 'foci' (or 'focuses').

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'crisis':
questions.explanation: Greek nouns ending in '-is' replace with '-es' (crisis -> crises).

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'phenomenon':
questions.explanation: Greek words ending in '-on' change to '-a' in the plural (phenomenon -> phenomena).

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of 'erratum':
questions.explanation: Latin nouns ending in '-um' take '-a' in the plural (erratum -> errata).

questions.question: Attach a suitable prefix to the root word 'way' to form a meaningful word:
questions.explanation: Prefix 'sub-' combines with 'way' to form 'subway' (an underground tunnel/pathway).

questions.question: Attach a suitable prefix to the root word 'obedient' to get its opposite:
questions.explanation: The negative prefix 'dis-' added to 'obedient' forms 'disobedient'.

questions.question: Form a derivative by adding the right suffix to the root word 'bright':
questions.explanation: Suffix '-ness' forms the abstract noun 'brightness'.

questions.question: Attach a suitable suffix to the word 'grace' to form an adjective:
questions.explanation: 'Grace' + '-ful' = 'graceful' (adjective).

questions.question: Attach a suitable prefix to the word 'fortunate' to form its antonym:
questions.explanation: 'Un-' added to 'fortunate' forms the antonym 'unfortunate'.

questions.question: Form a derivative by adding the correct prefix to the root word 'understand' to mean 'perceive incorrectly':
questions.explanation: Prefix 'mis-' + 'understand' forms 'misunderstand' (to interpret wrongly).

questions.explanation: GPS stands for Global Positioning System.

questions.question: Choose the correct expansion of 'WHO':
questions.explanation: WHO expands to World Health Organization.

questions.question: Choose the correct expansion of 'CCTV':
questions.explanation: CCTV stands for Closed-Circuit Television.

questions.question: Choose the correct expansion of 'SIM':
questions.explanation: SIM stands for Subscriber Identity Module.
